hero.title: Plant Your Sacred Wish
hero.subtitle: Speak or write what your heart holds dear. Embark on a peaceful seven-day positive reflection journey to nurture hope, clarity, and mindful action.
hero.feeNote: ₹10 one-time contribution • Digital service & reflection journey • No supernatural promises

howItWorks.title: How the Journey Unfolds
howItWorks.subtitle: A tranquil sanctuary designed to give voice to your deepest hopes with intention, dignity, and mindfulness.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Write your personal wish or record a peaceful voice message of up to 3 minutes.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Keep it completely private to your soul (default) or share anonymously with the community.
howItWorks.step3Desc: A modest one-time fee unlocking your personalized digital journey and audio storage.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Receive 7 daily mindful reflections and practical affirmations to nurture your inner strength.

journeyPreview.title: The Seven-Day Positive Reflection Journey
journeyPreview.subtitle: We never promise that a wish will magically come true in 7 days. Instead, we offer 7 daily beacons of light to guide your thoughts and actions.
journeyPreview.day1Desc: Your intention is acknowledged. Releasing anxious urgency into tranquil acceptance.
journeyPreview.day2Desc: Cultivating gentle patience. The flame that burns softly in the quiet night.
journeyPreview.day3Desc: Recognizing your resilience. You are the vessel through which change manifests.
journeyPreview.day4Desc: Anchoring dreams into tangible earth through one mindful, gentle action.
journeyPreview.day5Desc: Celebrating existing blessings to cultivate abundance and openness.
journeyPreview.day6Desc: Weathering doubts like passing clouds. Walking with quiet courage.
journeyPreview.day7Desc: Completing the reflection cycle with renewed clarity, calm, and grounded purpose.

ethics.title: Our Sacred Ethics & Truth
ethics.subtitle: Transparent, respectful, and grounded in truth. Here is what we stand for.
ethics.point1Desc: We do not claim divine miracles or assure outcomes. Your ₹10 fee pays for a mindful software service, private audio hosting, and daily reflection reminders.
ethics.point2Desc: Your wishes are private by default. Voice recordings are encrypted, stored in private storage, and never published without explicit choice.
ethics.point3Desc: Anonymous public submissions undergo strict human moderation to preserve peacefulness, purity, and mutual respect.

form.pageSubtitle: Take a deep breath. Release all hurry. Let your true heart speak.
form.textPlaceholder: Pour your heart out here... What are you yearning for? What peace, healing, or aspiration do you hold?
form.privateHint: Only you can access this wish using your secret Reference ID and PIN.
form.publicHint: Your identity is never shown. Displayed publicly only after review to inspire others.
form.voicePrompt: Speak from the heart. Up to 3 minutes of peaceful audio recording.
form.optionalContact: Optional: Email or Phone (for journey recovery)
form.feeExplanation: One-time contribution covering 3-minute secure audio storage, payment gateway processing, and 7 days of daily positive reflections.
form.consent1: I understand this ₹10 payment is for a digital reflection service and does not guarantee that my wish will come true.
form.consent2: I consent to storing my wish/voice note securely in accordance with the Privacy Policy.

success.title: Your Wish Has Been Received
success.subtitle: May peace and clarity illuminate your path over the coming days.
success.saveNotice: Please save your Reference ID and PIN to access your 7-Day Journey at any time.
success.day1Unlocked: Day 1 of Your Reflection Journey Is Now Unlocked

footer.rights: All rights reserved. Dedicated to peace, inner strength, and hope.
